## Motivation

<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->

Add optional [SynthID Text](https://github.com/google-deepmind/synthid-text) watermarking to ordinary generation and linear EAGLE/MTP speculative decoding, including explicit per-request opt-in/out within a shared batch.

Targeted validation and the requested public-model benchmark campaign are complete; repository-wide CI remains tracked separately in the footer.

## Modifications

<!-- Detail the changes made in this pull request. -->

- Add the hash-based Algorithm 5 transform, request-slot history, and Triton sampling/rejection kernels.
- Add `--watermark-algorithm synthid`, file-based server key configuration, and per-request `watermark.enabled` controls. Requests are OFF by default unless the server explicitly changes that policy.
- Integrate ordinary sampling, speculative target/draft proposals, mixed ON/OFF batches, CUDA graphs, overlap relays, slot reuse, and cache-flush invalidation.
- Adapt configuration to the current namespace field/hook APIs, keeping the existing Gumbel algorithm as the default.
- Add synthetic reference-law, state-lifecycle, policy, and CUDA-kernel regression tests.

The default candidate cap is 1,024. Wider caps use the existing wide transform; this PR does not add a new fused 2,048-candidate ordinary sampler.

## Accuracy Tests

<!-- If this pull request affects model outputs (e.g., changes to the kernel or model forward code), provide accuracy test results. -->

Targeted validation on an NVIDIA H200 using the isolated, upstream-pinned benchmark runtime (the full merged tip has fresh repository CI running):

| Command | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `python -m pip check` | Passed |
| `PYTHONPATH=python python test/registered/kernels/ops/sampling/test_synthid.py -f` | Passed: 7 tests, including reference-law parity, filtering order, live mixed-graph metadata, state commit, and sparse/dense rejection parity |
| `PYTHONPATH=python python test/registered/unit/sampling/test_synthid.py` | Passed: 19 tests after adapting to current upstream APIs |
| `PYTHONPATH=python python test/registered/unit/sampling/test_watermark_engine.py` | Passed: 9 tests |
| `PYTHONPATH=python python test/registered/unit/sampling/test_sampling_batch_info.py` | Passed: 50 tests |
| `PYTHONPATH=python python test/registered/unit/spec/test_eagle_draft_cuda_graph_runner.py` | Passed: 15 tests |
| `PYTHONPATH=python python test/registered/unit/spec/test_eagle_watermark_graph_state.py` | Passed: 2 tests |
| `PYTHONPATH=python python test/registered/unit/spec/test_eagle_seeded_coins.py` | Passed: 6 tests |
| `PYTHONPATH=python python test/registered/unit/managers/test_scheduler_flush_cache.py` | Passed: 10 tests |
| `PYTHONPATH=python python test/registered/unit/test_server_args_namespaces.py -f` | Passed: 5 tests |
| `PYTHONPATH=python python test/registered/unit/test_runtime_context_config_bags.py -f` | Passed: 18 tests |

Core versions: PyTorch 2.14.1 / CUDA 13.0, Transformers 5.19.0, FlashInfer 0.7.2, and sglang-kernel 0.4.10.

The changes above are pushed. Both public Qwen3.5 models also passed controlled ordinary/MTP, explicit OFF/ON token-and-stopping regression checks: **128 comparisons, zero differences**, using 16 fixed GSM8K questions per model and mode. This is a greedy-output regression check, not a full-dataset accuracy claim. See the [complete protocol and results](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45894#issuecomment-6369537887).

Broader CPU-CI compatibility failures were addressed in `c240fc637b`, including preserving legacy positional `ServerArgs` slots and initializing new optional metadata in existing fixtures. The six affected files passed **520 tests**:

| Command | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `PYTHONPATH=python python test/registered/unit/model_executor/test_mlp_sync_pad_unpad.py -f` | Passed: 11 tests |
| `PYTHONPATH=python python test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_disaggregation_wire.py -f` | Passed: 62 tests |
| `PYTHONPATH=python python test/registered/unit/test_model_overrides.py -f` | Passed: 115 tests |
| `PYTHONPATH=python python test/registered/unit/server_args/test_server_args.py -f` | Passed: 316 tests |
| `PYTHONPATH=python python test/registered/unit/managers/test_scheduler_flush_cache_after_retract.py -f` | Passed: 5 tests |
| `PYTHONPATH=python python test/registered/unit/spec/test_eagle_worker_v2_topk1_fastpath.py -f` | Passed: 11 tests |

`pre-commit run --files $(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR 74c08f3dc5 -- python test docs)` passed on the merged PR diff. Full upstream CI is re-running after the compatibility fixes and the latest-main merge; these targeted results do not imply every repository-wide CI job has passed.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

<!-- If this pull request impacts inference speed, provide benchmarking and profiling results. -->

Completed and independently verified **70/70 timed runs**, covering public `Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B` and `Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B` with ordinary and native-MTP decoding, including explicit OFF, ON, and MTP 50/50 controls. **SynthID candidate top-k=512 only; no top-k ablations.**

**[Full performance table, paired 95% confidence intervals, public asset revisions, and protocol](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45894#issuecomment-6369537887)**

Mean throughput losses relative to the same-PR explicit-OFF controls:

| Model | Ordinary ON | MTP ON | MTP 50/50 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Qwen3.5-4B | 0.89% [0.79, 1.00] | 4.00% [3.68, 4.31] | 9.89% [9.00, 10.78] |
| Qwen3.5-9B | 0.36% [-0.07, 0.79] | 1.67% [-1.38, 4.72] | 6.32% [3.55, 9.09] |

Five paired blocks; one H200; BF16/FA3/FlashInfer; decode CUDA graphs and overlap enabled; temperature 1; concurrency 8; fixed 256-token outputs; 32 short warmups followed by a cache flush before each timed run. Performance data: pinned `HuggingFaceTB/smol-smoltalk` (Apache-2.0). Correctness data: pinned `openai/gsm8k` (MIT).

Performance evidence is explicitly pinned to PR commit `ff058455c40fae45784d0e98cb66368f1e1b7716` versus unmodified upstream `a904e4d31a`, using the dependency versions listed above. It is not a remeasurement of the later upstream dependency changes. No kernel profiling claim is made.

2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.

4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

[Approve preview](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45894/checks?check_run_id=126253420214)

## Public-model SynthID benchmark: Qwen3.5-4B and 9B, K=512

Completed and independently verified **70/70 timed runs**: seven configurations × two public models × five paired replication blocks. **No top-k ablations** were run.

Benchmarked PR commit: `ff058455c40fae45784d0e98cb66368f1e1b7716`. Unmodified upstream control: `a904e4d31a`.

### Performance

| Model | Mode / policy | Output tok/s | Throughput loss vs port OFF [95% CI] | p95 TPOT |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 4B | Ordinary upstream baseline | 1,980.9 | — | 3.714 ms |
| 4B | Ordinary explicit OFF | 1,994.9 | Reference | 3.714 ms |
| 4B | **Ordinary ON** | **1,977.1** | **0.89% [0.79, 1.00]** | 3.720 ms |
| 4B | MTP upstream baseline | 2,082.7 | — | 4.369 ms |
| 4B | MTP explicit OFF | 2,134.8 | Reference | 4.240 ms |
| 4B | **MTP ON** | **2,049.6** | **4.00% [3.68, 4.31]** | 4.472 ms |
| 4B | **MTP 50/50 ON/OFF** | **1,923.6** | **9.89% [9.00, 10.78]** | 4.849 ms |
| 9B | Ordinary upstream baseline | 1,354.5 | — | 5.585 ms |
| 9B | Ordinary explicit OFF | 1,355.7 | Reference | 5.588 ms |
| 9B | **Ordinary ON** | **1,350.8** | **0.36% [-0.07, 0.79]** | 5.588 ms |
| 9B | MTP upstream baseline | 1,696.1 | — | 5.366 ms |
| 9B | MTP explicit OFF | 1,716.5 | Reference | 5.259 ms |
| 9B | **MTP ON** | **1,687.1** | **1.67% [-1.38, 4.72]** | 5.463 ms |
| 9B | **MTP 50/50 ON/OFF** | **1,607.3** | **6.32% [3.55, 9.09]** | 5.654 ms |

“Explicit OFF” uses this PR's implementation with SynthID capability enabled but disabled per request. Losses are paired within each replication block against that same-model/mode OFF control, **not** the separate upstream baseline. Throughput and p95 TPOT columns are means of five run-level measurements. Confidence intervals use the five paired percentage losses and Student's t distribution, df=4; no repetitions were removed. The 9B ordinary-ON and MTP-ON intervals include zero.

At this setting, ordinary watermarking costs less than 1% in mean throughput. Always-ON MTP costs about 4.0% for 4B and 1.7% for 9B; the explicit 50/50 MTP mixture is the larger measured overhead.

### Protocol and public assets

- Hardware/runtime: **one NVIDIA H200**, BF16, TP=1, FA3 attention, FlashInfer sampling, overlap scheduling enabled, full **decode** CUDA graphs with batch sizes 1/2/4/8; prefill CUDA graphs disabled. Language-only serving, context length 2,048, chunked prefill 2,048, max-running-requests 8, static memory fraction 0.60.
- Models: [`Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B`](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B/tree/851bf6e806efd8d0a36b00ddf55e13ccb7b8cd0a), revision `851bf6e806efd8d0a36b00ddf55e13ccb7b8cd0a`; [`Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B`](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B/tree/c202236235762e1c871ad0ccb60c8ee5ba337b9a), revision `c202236235762e1c871ad0ccb60c8ee5ba337b9a`. All weight shards were SHA-256 checked against their public metadata; both checkpoints include native MTP tensors.
- Performance data: [`HuggingFaceTB/smol-smoltalk`](https://huggingface.co/datasets/HuggingFaceTB/smol-smoltalk/tree/f73fe857d519ff6ac5af2ea67c4d3834da7b8bcc), **Apache-2.0**, pinned revision `f73fe857d519ff6ac5af2ea67c4d3834da7b8bcc`, test split. Conversation prefixes were deduplicated, SHA-256 ordered, chat-templated with thinking disabled, and selected without prompt truncation to contain 128–1,024 input tokens.
- Each timed run: the same **256 prompts × 256 output tokens**, temperature **1.0**, unlimited request top-k, top-p 1, min-p 0, offered request rate ∞, max client concurrency **8**. Exactly **17,920 timed requests / 4,587,520 output tokens** across the experiment. `ignore_eos=true` is used **only for these fixed-output performance runs**.
- Before every timed run: **32 short warmup requests**, followed by the stock SGLang cache-flush operation. Every request success, fixed output length, flush completion, and mixed-policy count was checked. Mixed runs contain exactly **128 explicit ON + 128 explicit OFF** requests.
- MTP: NEXTN resolved to linear EAGLE, **3 speculative steps / 4 draft tokens / eagle-topk=1**, exact rejection sampling, using each public model's native MTP weights.
- SynthID: **candidate cap 512**, 30 public synthetic test keys (`1009 + 7919*i`, `i=0..29`), n-gram length 5, context history 1,024, request-opt-in default. No production key material was used.
- Dependencies: PyTorch **2.14.1 / CUDA 13.0**, Transformers **5.19.0**, FlashInfer **0.7.2**, sglang-kernel **0.4.10**, isolated from older release environments.

Client request execution, timing, and metrics use the stock `sglang.benchmark.serving` implementation. The input adapter supplies fixed public `DatasetRow` token IDs and per-request `watermark.enabled` overrides. All 70 persisted cells were checked for completeness, exact output shape, ON/OFF counts, throughput arithmetic, and independently recomputed latency percentiles before calculating the paired intervals.

### Correctness/regression checks

Using [`openai/gsm8k`](https://huggingface.co/datasets/openai/gsm8k/tree/740312add88f781978c0658806c59bc2815b9866), **MIT**, revision `740312add88f781978c0658806c59bc2815b9866`:

- **16 fixed public questions per model and decoding mode**, normal EOS/stopping behavior, matched serial batches and cold-cache policy groups.
- Ported ordinary and MTP generation with explicit OFF and ON matched their corresponding upstream baseline **token-for-token and in finish reason**: **64 comparisons for 4B + 64 for 9B, zero differences**.
- This is a controlled greedy-output regression check, **not a claim of full-dataset GSM8K accuracy**. Positive-temperature ON/OFF/mixed serving is exercised by the performance runs above; distribution/state correctness is also covered by the CPU/CUDA reference-law tests.

The controlled regression exposed an upstream-prefill proposal-law difference during porting. Commit `ff058455c4` preserves the original unpinned initial draft proposal for greedy prefill and adds a regression test; the cohort above passes with that fix.

The benchmark servers have exited and the H200 is idle after completion.

+---
+title: "SynthID Text Watermarking"
+description: "Configure per-request SynthID Text watermarking for ordinary and linear speculative generation."
+---
+
+SGLang supports the hash-based [SynthID Text](https://github.com/google-deepmind/synthid-text) tournament transform for NVIDIA CUDA generation. Watermarking is OFF by default and can be enabled per request without truncating OFF requests to the watermark candidate cap.
+
+For the default Aaronson-Gumbel algorithm, see [Text Watermarking](/docs/advanced_features/text_watermarking).
+
+## Server configuration
+
+Store the configuration in a file readable only by the server account. The following keys are public test values, not production secrets:
+
+```json
+{
+  "keys": [654, 400, 836, 123],
+  "ngram_len": 5,
+  "top_k": 512,
+  "context_history_size": 1024,
+  "default_enabled": false,
+  "enforce_all": false
+}
+```
+
+```bash
+chmod 600 /run/secrets/synthid.json
+python -m sglang.launch_server \
+  --model-path Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B \
+  --enable-watermark \
+  --watermark-algorithm synthid \
+  --watermark-config /run/secrets/synthid.json
+```
+
+SynthID configuration must be a file path, not inline JSON. Instead of `keys`, the configuration may contain `key_file`, pointing to a separate JSON file containing the integer key list. Do not combine both fields.
+
+| Field | Default | Meaning |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `keys` or `key_file` | Required | Up to 64 signed 64-bit integer layer keys. |
+| `ngram_len` | `5` | Hash-context n-gram length; must be at least 2. |
+| `top_k` | `1024` | Server-wide watermark candidate cap, from 2 to 65,536, clamped to the vocabulary size. |
+| `context_history_size` | `1024` | Number of prior eligible context hashes retained per request. |
+| `skip_first_ngram_calls` | `false` | Skip watermarking the first `ngram_len - 1` generated tokens. |
+| `default_enabled` | `false` | Enable watermarking when a request omits its control. Explicit OFF remains allowed. |
+| `enforce_all` | `false` | Enable watermarking for every request and reject explicit OFF. |
+
+The `--synthid-watermark-key-file` and corresponding `--synthid-watermark-*` parameter flags are also supported. Supplying a SynthID key file implicitly selects the SynthID capability, but does not change the request-opt-in default.
+
+Keys, n-gram parameters, and the candidate cap are server-wide. Requests cannot override SynthID keys or context settings. Protect configuration files, process/GPU core dumps, and any other artifacts that can contain in-memory keys.
+
+## Request control
+
+For the native API, pass `watermark` at the request top level or inside `sampling_params`, but not both:
+
+```bash
+curl http://127.0.0.1:30000/generate \
+  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
+  -d '{
+    "text": "Explain why the sky is blue.",
+    "sampling_params": {
+      "temperature": 1.0,
+      "max_new_tokens": 128,
+      "watermark": {"enabled": true}
+    }
+  }'
+```
+
+The OpenAI-compatible completion and chat APIs accept the same `watermark` object at the request top level. Use `{"enabled": false}` for explicit opt-out. Omitted controls remain OFF unless the server sets `default_enabled` or `enforce_all`.
+
+ON and OFF requests can share a batch. OFF requests retain ordinary full-vocabulary sampling and logprob conventions. Greedy requests retain their unwatermarked argmax and do not provide a meaningful watermark signal.
+
+## Ordinary sampling
+
+Ordinary generation applies these steps:
+
+1. Apply the standard penalties, grammar constraints, custom logit processors, and logit bias.
+2. Apply the request temperature.
+3. Select the SynthID candidate cap and apply the request's top-k, top-p, and min-p filters within it.
+4. Normalize, apply the SynthID tournament, and sample without applying the filters again.
+
+An unlimited request top-k still uses the server's candidate cap for ON requests. OFF requests are not subject to that cap. The implementation preserves each sampling backend's filtering conventions.
+
+Eligible single-device stochastic requests use fused Triton sampling through candidate cap 1,024. Wider caps use a separate GPU path; they do not fall back to the CPU. Benchmark the chosen cap for the target workload.
+
+## Output scores and sampling masks
+
+By default, returned generated-token logprobs describe the unwatermarked reference logits after request temperature, before request filters and watermarking. Existing greedy and prompt-logprob conventions are preserved.
+
+| Reporting mode | Generated-token scores |
+| --- | --- |
+| Default | Unwatermarked reference scores. |
+| `SGLANG_RETURN_ORIGINAL_LOGPROB=true` | Pre-temperature, pre-filter, pre-watermark scores after standard logit preprocessing. |
+| `SGLANG_RETURN_WATERMARKED_LOGPROB=true` | Final filtered and watermarked sampling probabilities for ON rows. |
+
+The two explicit reporting flags are mutually exclusive. Watermarked-score reporting requires SynthID and non-speculative generation. These flags change reporting, not token sampling.
+
+Sampling-mask output and selected-action sampling logprobs describe the realized sampling distribution independently of the reference-logprob reporting mode.
+
+## Speculative decoding
+
+SynthID supports single-layer linear EAGLE/NEXTN and STANDALONE speculation with `--speculative-eagle-topk 1` and `--speculative-use-rejection-sampling`. For a model with native MTP weights:
+
+```bash
+python -m sglang.launch_server \
+  --model-path Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B \
+  --speculative-algorithm NEXTN \
+  --speculative-draft-model-path Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B \
+  --speculative-num-steps 3 \
+  --speculative-eagle-topk 1 \
+  --speculative-num-draft-tokens 4 \
+  --speculative-use-rejection-sampling \
+  --enable-watermark \
+  --watermark-algorithm synthid \
+  --watermark-config /run/secrets/synthid.json
+```
+
+Draft and target distributions use the same provisional context. Only accepted tokens, including the bonus token, update stable request state. Rejection sampling preserves the target watermarked distribution.
+
+Eligible stochastic draft batches use CUDA graphs with live request masks and context state. Sparse verification is available through candidate cap 1,024; wider candidates use dense rejection after scattering their probabilities. Mixed ON/OFF batches retain full-vocabulary OFF proposals.
+
+Request filters, seeded sampling, unsupported graph-state dimensions, and mixed greedy/stochastic batches use correctness-preserving fallback paths. Speculative watermarked-score reporting, tree speculation, multi-layer EAGLE, token maps, pipeline-parallel speculation, PD disaggregation, diffusion, embedding models, and other speculative algorithms are rejected.
+
+## State and detection
+
+The context history is a bounded ring of eligible calls, not an unlimited set of distinct contexts. A context can become eligible again after eviction. Discarded intermediate chunked-prefill samples do not advance stable history.
+
+Slot generations remain monotonic across cache flushes. A flush invalidates cached watermark state, and reused slots are reinitialized before the next watermarked decode.
+
+Use the official SynthID detector with the same tokenizer, keys, n-gram configuration, and algorithm version. Calibrate detection thresholds against output length and the required false-positive rate; a low detector score is not proof of authorship.

 This feature can support transparency controls such as the machine-readable marking and detectability described in [Article 50 of the EU AI Act](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/1689/oj). It is one technical signal, not a complete compliance program or proof of authorship.
 
+## Select an algorithm
+
+Aaronson-Gumbel remains the default when `--enable-watermark` is set without an algorithm selector. Use `--watermark-algorithm gumbel` to select it explicitly. The configuration, request keys, and detector described on this page apply to Gumbel.

See [SynthID Text Watermarking](/docs/advanced_features/synthid_text_watermarking) for its candidate cap, key format, speculative decoding support, and reporting conventions.

+# Copyright 2026 SGLang Team

+# You may obtain a copy of the License at

+# limitations under the License.
+# ==============================================================================
+"""Fused Triton implementation of the SynthID sparse tournament transform."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+_HASH_MULTIPLIER = tl.constexpr(6364136223846793005)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _accumulate_hash(value, data):
+    return (value + data) * _HASH_MULTIPLIER + 1
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _projected_context_hash(
+    context_ptr,
+    verify_tokens_ptr,
+    slot,
+    request,
+    step,
+    context_stride: tl.constexpr,
+    verify_stride: tl.constexpr,
+    context_width: tl.constexpr,
+    hash_iv,
+):
+    context_hash = hash_iv.to(tl.int64)
+    for context_index in range(context_width):
+        base_index = context_index + step
+        draft_index = 1 + context_index + step - context_width
+        from_base = base_index < context_width
+        base_token = tl.load(
+            context_ptr + slot * context_stride + base_index,
+            mask=from_base,
+            other=0,
+        )
+        draft_token = tl.load(
+            verify_tokens_ptr + request * verify_stride + draft_index,
+            mask=~from_base,
+            other=0,
+        )
+        context_hash = _accumulate_hash(
+            context_hash,
+            tl.where(from_base, base_token, draft_token).to(tl.int64),
+        )
+    return context_hash
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _synthid_topk_kernel(
+    scores_ptr,
+    token_ids_ptr,
+    context_hashes_ptr,
+    keys_ptr,
+    apply_mask_ptr,
+    temperatures_ptr,
+    exponential_noise_ptr,
+    output_ptr,
+    output_token_ids_ptr,
+    output_sampled_probs_ptr,
+    output_sorted_tokens_ptr,
+    score_stride,
+    token_stride,
+    noise_stride,
+    output_stride,
+    temperature_stride,
+    num_candidates: tl.constexpr,
+    depth: tl.constexpr,
+    return_probs: tl.constexpr,
+    sample_token: tl.constexpr,
+    sort_output: tl.constexpr,
+    apply_temperature: tl.constexpr,
+    rows_per_request: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    offsets = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)
+    mask = offsets < num_candidates
+
+    scores = tl.load(
+        scores_ptr + row * score_stride + offsets,
+        mask=mask,
+        other=-float("inf"),
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    if apply_temperature:
+        temperature = tl.load(
+            temperatures_ptr + (row // rows_per_request) * temperature_stride
+        )
+        scores = tl.div_rn(scores, temperature)
+    max_score = tl.max(scores, axis=0)
+    base_probs = tl.exp(scores - max_score)
+    base_probs = tl.where(mask, base_probs, 0.0)
+    base_probs /= tl.sum(base_probs, axis=0)
+    probs = base_probs
+
+    token_ids = tl.load(
+        token_ids_ptr + row * token_stride + offsets, mask=mask, other=0
+    ).to(tl.int64)
+    context_hash = tl.load(context_hashes_ptr + row).to(tl.int64)
+    candidate_hashes = _accumulate_hash(context_hash, token_ids)
+
+    for key_index in range(depth):
+        key = tl.load(keys_ptr + key_index).to(tl.int64)
+        hashes = _accumulate_hash(candidate_hashes, key)
+        for _ in range(12):
+            hashes = _accumulate_hash(hashes, 1) >> 5
+        g_values = ((hashes >> 30) & 1).to(tl.float32)
+        g_values = tl.where(mask, g_values, 0.0)
+        g_mass = tl.sum(g_values * probs, axis=0)
+        probs *= 1.0 + g_values - g_mass
+
+    should_apply = tl.load(apply_mask_ptr + row)
+    selected_probs = tl.where(should_apply, probs, base_probs)
+    if return_probs:
+        output = tl.where(mask, selected_probs, 0.0)
+    else:
+        output = tl.log(probs)
+        output = tl.where(probs > 0.0, output, -1.0e12)
+        output = tl.where(should_apply, output, scores)
+    if sort_output:
+        # Keep the original candidate/noise pairing; reorder only stored proposals.
+        packed = token_ids.to(tl.uint64) * BLOCK_SIZE + offsets.to(tl.uint64)
+        packed = tl.where(mask, packed, 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF)
+        packed = tl.sort(packed, descending=False)
+        order = tl.where(mask, packed % BLOCK_SIZE, 0).to(tl.int32)
+        sorted_output = tl.gather(output, order, axis=0)
+        tl.store(
+            output_sorted_tokens_ptr + row * output_stride + offsets,
+            (packed // BLOCK_SIZE).to(tl.int64),
+            mask=mask,
+        )
+        tl.store(output_ptr + row * output_stride + offsets, sorted_output, mask=mask)
+    else:
+        tl.store(output_ptr + row * output_stride + offsets, output, mask=mask)
+
+    if sample_token:
+        noise = tl.load(
+            exponential_noise_ptr + row * noise_stride + offsets,
+            mask=mask,
+            other=1.0,
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        sampling_scores = tl.where(
+            mask,
+            selected_probs / tl.maximum(noise, 1.1754943508222875e-38),
+            -float("inf"),
+        )
+        sampled_index = tl.argmax(sampling_scores, axis=0)
+        sampled_token_id = tl.sum(
+            tl.where(offsets == sampled_index, token_ids, 0),
+            axis=0,
+        )
+        sampled_prob = tl.sum(
+            tl.where(offsets == sampled_index, selected_probs, 0.0),
+            axis=0,
+        )
+        tl.store(output_token_ids_ptr + row, sampled_token_id)
+        tl.store(output_sampled_probs_ptr + row, sampled_prob)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _synthid_wide_topk_kernel(
+    scores_ptr,
+    token_ids_ptr,
+    context_hashes_ptr,
+    keys_ptr,
+    apply_mask_ptr,
+    output_ptr,
+    g_bits_ptr,
+    score_stride,
+    token_stride,
+    output_stride,
+    g_bits_stride,
+    num_candidates,
+    depth,
+    return_probs: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    offsets = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)
+    score_base = scores_ptr + row * score_stride
+    token_base = token_ids_ptr + row * token_stride
+    output_base = output_ptr + row * output_stride
+    g_bits_base = g_bits_ptr + row * g_bits_stride
+
+    max_score = -float("inf")
+    for start in tl.range(0, num_candidates, BLOCK_SIZE):
+        mask = start + offsets < num_candidates
+        scores = tl.load(score_base + start + offsets, mask=mask, other=-float("inf"))
+        max_score = tl.maximum(max_score, tl.max(scores, axis=0))
+
+    should_apply = tl.load(apply_mask_ptr + row)
+    context_hash = tl.load(context_hashes_ptr + row).to(tl.int64)
+    denominator = 0.0
+    for start in tl.range(0, num_candidates, BLOCK_SIZE):
+        candidate_offsets = start + offsets
+        mask = candidate_offsets < num_candidates
+        scores = tl.load(
+            score_base + candidate_offsets,
+            mask=mask,
+            other=-float("inf"),
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        exp_scores = tl.where(mask, tl.exp(scores - max_score), 0.0)
+        denominator += tl.sum(exp_scores, axis=0)
+        tl.store(output_base + candidate_offsets, exp_scores, mask=mask)
+
+        token_ids = tl.load(
+            token_base + candidate_offsets,
+            mask=mask,
+            other=0,
+        ).to(tl.int64)
+        candidate_hashes = _accumulate_hash(context_hash, token_ids)
+        g_bits = token_ids ^ token_ids
+        for key_index in tl.range(0, depth):
+            key = tl.load(keys_ptr + key_index).to(tl.int64)
+            hashes = _accumulate_hash(candidate_hashes, key)
+            for _ in range(12):
+                hashes = _accumulate_hash(hashes, 1) >> 5
+            g_value = ((hashes >> 30) & 1).to(tl.int64)
+            g_bits |= g_value << key_index
+        g_bits = tl.where(should_apply, g_bits, 0)
+        tl.store(g_bits_base + candidate_offsets, g_bits, mask=mask)
+
+    denominator = tl.maximum(denominator, 1.1754943508222875e-38)
+    current_mass = 0.0
+    for start in tl.range(0, num_candidates, BLOCK_SIZE):
+        candidate_offsets = start + offsets
+        mask = candidate_offsets < num_candidates
+        probs = tl.load(output_base + candidate_offsets, mask=mask, other=0.0)
+        probs /= denominator
+        g_bits = tl.load(g_bits_base + candidate_offsets, mask=mask, other=0)
+        current_mass += tl.sum(probs * (g_bits & 1).to(tl.float32), axis=0)
+        tl.store(output_base + candidate_offsets, probs, mask=mask)
+
+    for key_index in tl.range(0, depth):
+        next_mass = 0.0
+        for start in tl.range(0, num_candidates, BLOCK_SIZE):
+            candidate_offsets = start + offsets
+            mask = candidate_offsets < num_candidates
+            probs = tl.load(output_base + candidate_offsets, mask=mask, other=0.0)
+            g_bits = tl.load(g_bits_base + candidate_offsets, mask=mask, other=0)
+            g_value = ((g_bits >> key_index) & 1).to(tl.float32)
+            probs *= 1.0 + g_value - current_mass
+            if key_index + 1 < depth:
+                next_g_value = ((g_bits >> (key_index + 1)) & 1).to(tl.float32)
+                next_mass += tl.sum(probs * next_g_value, axis=0)
+                tl.store(output_base + candidate_offsets, probs, mask=mask)
+            else:
+                if return_probs:
+                    output = probs
+                else:
+                    output = tl.where(probs > 0.0, tl.log(probs), -1.0e12)
+                    original_scores = tl.load(
+                        score_base + candidate_offsets,
+                        mask=mask,
+                        other=-float("inf"),
+                    )
+                    output = tl.where(should_apply, output, original_scores)
+                tl.store(output_base + candidate_offsets, output, mask=mask)
+        current_mass = next_mass
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _synthid_sample_and_commit_kernel(
+    scores_ptr,
+    token_ids_ptr,
+    exponential_noise_ptr,
+    temperatures_ptr,
+    slot_indices_ptr,
+    context_ptr,
+    context_history_ptr,
+    history_cursor_ptr,
+    num_calls_ptr,
+    keys_ptr,
+    commit_mask_ptr,
+    output_token_ids_ptr,
+    score_stride,
+    token_stride,
+    noise_stride,
+    temperature_stride,
+    context_stride,
+    history_stride,
+    hash_iv,
+    num_candidates: tl.constexpr,
+    context_width: tl.constexpr,
+    history_size: tl.constexpr,
+    depth: tl.constexpr,
+    commit_state: tl.constexpr,
+    use_exponential_noise: tl.constexpr,
+    skip_first_ngram_calls: tl.constexpr,
+    CANDIDATE_BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    HISTORY_BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    slot = tl.load(slot_indices_ptr + row).to(tl.int64)
+    candidate_offsets = tl.arange(0, CANDIDATE_BLOCK_SIZE)
+    candidate_mask = candidate_offsets < num_candidates
+
+    scores = tl.load(
+        scores_ptr + row * score_stride + candidate_offsets,
+        mask=candidate_mask,
+        other=-float("inf"),
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    temperature = tl.load(temperatures_ptr + row * temperature_stride).to(tl.float32)
+    scores /= temperature
+
+    valid_mask = candidate_mask & (scores > -float("inf"))
+    max_score = tl.max(scores, axis=0)
+    base_probs = tl.exp(scores - max_score)
+    base_probs = tl.where(valid_mask, base_probs, 0.0)
+    base_probs /= tl.sum(base_probs, axis=0)
+    probs = base_probs
+
+    context_hash = hash_iv.to(tl.int64)
+    for context_index in range(context_width):
+        context_token = tl.load(context_ptr + slot * context_stride + context_index).to(
+            tl.int64
+        )
+        context_hash = _accumulate_hash(context_hash, context_token)
+
+    call_number = tl.load(num_calls_ptr + slot).to(tl.int64) + 1
+    eligible = True
+    if skip_first_ngram_calls:
+        eligible = call_number >= context_width + 1
+
+    history_offsets = tl.arange(0, HISTORY_BLOCK_SIZE)
+    history_mask = history_offsets < history_size
+    history_values = tl.load(
+        context_history_ptr + slot * history_stride + history_offsets,
+        mask=history_mask,
+        other=0,
+    ).to(tl.int64)
+    repeated = (
+        tl.max(
+            tl.where(
+                history_mask & (history_values == context_hash),
+                1,
+                0,
+            ),
+            axis=0,
+        )
+        != 0
+    )
+
+    token_ids = tl.load(
+        token_ids_ptr + row * token_stride + candidate_offsets,
+        mask=candidate_mask,
+        other=0,
+    ).to(tl.int64)
+    candidate_hashes = _accumulate_hash(context_hash, token_ids)
+    for key_index in range(depth):
+        key = tl.load(keys_ptr + key_index).to(tl.int64)
+        hashes = _accumulate_hash(candidate_hashes, key)
+        for _ in range(12):
+            hashes = _accumulate_hash(hashes, 1) >> 5
+        g_values = ((hashes >> 30) & 1).to(tl.float32)
+        g_values = tl.where(valid_mask, g_values, 0.0)
+        g_mass = tl.sum(g_values * probs, axis=0)
+        probs *= 1.0 + g_values - g_mass
+
+    selection_probs = tl.where(eligible & ~repeated, probs, base_probs)
+    selection_scores = selection_probs
+    if use_exponential_noise:
+        noise = tl.load(
+            exponential_noise_ptr + row * noise_stride + candidate_offsets,
+            mask=valid_mask,
+            other=1.0,
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        selection_scores /= tl.maximum(noise, 1.1754943508222875e-38)
+    selection_scores = tl.where(
+        valid_mask,
+        selection_scores,
+        -float("inf"),
+    )
+    selected_index = tl.argmax(selection_scores, axis=0)
+    selected_token_id = tl.sum(
+        tl.where(candidate_offsets == selected_index, token_ids, 0),
+        axis=0,
+    )
+    tl.store(output_token_ids_ptr + row, selected_token_id)
+
+    if commit_state:
+        should_commit = tl.load(commit_mask_ptr + row)
+        history_cursor = tl.load(history_cursor_ptr + slot).to(tl.int64)
+        tl.store(
+            context_history_ptr + slot * history_stride + history_cursor,
+            context_hash,
+            mask=should_commit & eligible,
+        )
+        tl.store(
+            history_cursor_ptr + slot,
+            (history_cursor + 1) % history_size,
+            mask=should_commit & eligible,
+        )
+        for context_index in range(context_width - 1):
+            next_context_token = tl.load(
+                context_ptr + slot * context_stride + context_index + 1
+            )
+            tl.store(
+                context_ptr + slot * context_stride + context_index,
+                next_context_token,
+                mask=should_commit,
+            )
+        tl.store(
+            context_ptr + slot * context_stride + context_width - 1,
+            selected_token_id,
+            mask=should_commit,
+        )
+        tl.store(num_calls_ptr + slot, call_number, mask=should_commit)
+

+@triton.jit
+def _synthid_project_kernel(
+    slot_indices_ptr,
+    verify_tokens_ptr,
+    context_ptr,
+    context_history_ptr,
+    history_cursor_ptr,
+    num_calls_ptr,
+    context_hashes_ptr,
+    apply_mask_ptr,
+    verify_stride,
+    context_stride,
+    history_stride,
+    hash_iv,
+    verify_width: tl.constexpr,
+    context_width: tl.constexpr,
+    history_size: tl.constexpr,
+    skip_first_ngram_calls: tl.constexpr,
+    HISTORY_BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    flat_row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    request = flat_row // verify_width
+    step = flat_row % verify_width
+    slot = tl.load(slot_indices_ptr + request).to(tl.int64)
+    context_hash = _projected_context_hash(
+        context_ptr,
+        verify_tokens_ptr,
+        slot,
+        request,
+        step,
+        context_stride=context_stride,
+        verify_stride=verify_stride,
+        context_width=context_width,
+        hash_iv=hash_iv,
+    )
+
+    base_num_calls = tl.load(num_calls_ptr + slot).to(tl.int64)
+    call_number = base_num_calls + step + 1
+    eligible = True
+    if skip_first_ngram_calls:
+        eligible = call_number >= context_width + 1
+
+    history_offsets = tl.arange(0, HISTORY_BLOCK_SIZE)
+    history_mask = history_offsets < history_size
+    history_values = tl.load(
+        context_history_ptr + slot * history_stride + history_offsets,
+        mask=history_mask,
+        other=0,
+    ).to(tl.int64)
+    projected_cursor = tl.load(history_cursor_ptr + slot).to(tl.int64)
+    for previous_step in range(verify_width):
+        active_previous = previous_step < step
+        previous_call_number = base_num_calls + previous_step + 1
+        previous_eligible = active_previous
+        if skip_first_ngram_calls:
+            previous_eligible &= previous_call_number >= context_width + 1
+        previous_history_hash = _projected_context_hash(
+            context_ptr,
+            verify_tokens_ptr,
+            slot,
+            request,
+            previous_step,
+            context_stride=context_stride,
+            verify_stride=verify_stride,
+            context_width=context_width,
+            hash_iv=hash_iv,
+        )
+        history_values = tl.where(
+            history_mask & previous_eligible & (history_offsets == projected_cursor),
+            previous_history_hash,
+            history_values,
+        )
+        projected_cursor = tl.where(
+            previous_eligible,
+            (projected_cursor + 1) % history_size,
+            projected_cursor,
+        )
+
+    repeated = (
+        tl.max(
+            tl.where(
+                history_mask & (history_values == context_hash),
+                1,
+                0,
+            ),
+            axis=0,
+        )
+        != 0
+    )
+    tl.store(context_hashes_ptr + flat_row, context_hash)
+    tl.store(apply_mask_ptr + flat_row, eligible & ~repeated)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _synthid_commit_kernel(
+    token_ids_ptr,
+    lengths_ptr,
+    slot_indices_ptr,
+    context_ptr,
+    context_history_ptr,
+    history_cursor_ptr,
+    num_calls_ptr,
+    token_stride,
+    context_stride,
+    history_stride,
+    hash_iv,
+    use_lengths: tl.constexpr,
+    max_tokens: tl.constexpr,
+    context_width: tl.constexpr,
+    history_size: tl.constexpr,
+    skip_first_ngram_calls: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    slot = tl.load(slot_indices_ptr + row).to(tl.int64)
+    length = 1
+    if use_lengths:
+        length = tl.load(lengths_ptr + row).to(tl.int64)
+    history_cursor = tl.load(history_cursor_ptr + slot).to(tl.int64)
+    num_calls = tl.load(num_calls_ptr + slot).to(tl.int64)
+
+    for step in range(max_tokens):
+        committed = step < length
+        context_hash = hash_iv.to(tl.int64)
+        for context_index in range(context_width):
+            context_token = tl.load(
+                context_ptr + slot * context_stride + context_index
+            ).to(tl.int64)
+            context_hash = _accumulate_hash(context_hash, context_token)
+
+        call_number = num_calls + 1
+        record = committed
+        if skip_first_ngram_calls:
+            record &= call_number >= context_width + 1
+        tl.store(
+            context_history_ptr + slot * history_stride + history_cursor,
+            context_hash,
+            mask=record,
+        )
+        history_cursor = tl.where(
+            record,
+            (history_cursor + 1) % history_size,
+            history_cursor,
+        )
+
+        for context_index in range(context_width - 1):
+            next_context_token = tl.load(
+                context_ptr + slot * context_stride + context_index + 1
+            )
+            tl.store(
+                context_ptr + slot * context_stride + context_index,
+                next_context_token,
+                mask=committed,
+            )
+        token_id = tl.load(
+            token_ids_ptr + row * token_stride + step,
+            mask=committed,
+            other=0,
+        )
+        tl.store(
+            context_ptr + slot * context_stride + context_width - 1,
+            token_id,
+            mask=committed,
+        )
+        num_calls += committed.to(tl.int64)
+
+    tl.store(history_cursor_ptr + slot, history_cursor)
+    tl.store(num_calls_ptr + slot, num_calls)
+

+def watermark_topk_scores_triton(

+        raise ValueError("scores and token_ids must be matching 2D tensors.")
+    if scores.stride(1) != 1 or token_ids.stride(1) != 1:
+        raise ValueError("scores and token_ids must be contiguous by row.")
+    if context_hashes.shape != (scores.shape[0],):
+        raise ValueError("context_hashes must have one value per score row.")
+    if apply_mask.shape != (scores.shape[0],):
+        raise ValueError("apply_mask must have one value per score row.")
+
+    output = torch.empty_like(scores)

+        g_bits = torch.empty_like(token_ids)

+            BLOCK_SIZE=1024,
+            num_warps=8,

+    _synthid_topk_kernel[(scores.shape[0],)](
+        scores,
+        token_ids,
+        context_hashes,
+        keys,
+        apply_mask,
+        scores,
+        scores,
+        output,
+        output,
+        output,
+        output,
+        scores.stride(0),
+        token_ids.stride(0),
+        0,
+        output.stride(0),
+        0,
+        num_candidates=scores.shape[1],
+        depth=keys.numel(),
+        return_probs=False,
+        sample_token=False,
+        sort_output=False,
+        apply_temperature=False,

+def watermark_topk_probs_and_sample_triton(
+    scores: torch.Tensor,
+    token_ids: torch.Tensor,
+    context_hashes: torch.Tensor,

+    apply_mask: torch.Tensor,

+    if not scores.is_cuda:
+        raise ValueError("The fused SynthID probability path requires CUDA tensors.")
+    if scores.dtype != torch.float32:
+        raise ValueError(f"Scores must be float32, got {scores.dtype}.")
+    if scores.ndim != 2 or token_ids.shape != scores.shape:
+        raise ValueError("scores and token_ids must be matching 2D tensors.")
+    if context_hashes.shape != (scores.shape[0],):
+        raise ValueError("context_hashes must have one value per score row.")
+    if apply_mask.shape != (scores.shape[0],):
+        raise ValueError("apply_mask must have one value per score row.")
+    if exponential_noise is not None and exponential_noise.shape != scores.shape:
+        raise ValueError("exponential_noise must match scores.")
+
+    sample_token = exponential_noise is not None
+    output_probs = torch.empty_like(scores)

+            sorted_tokens.shape != token_ids.shape

+        if scores.shape[1] > 1024:
+            raise ValueError("Fused proposal sorting requires top-k <= 1024.")

+        torch.empty(scores.shape[0], dtype=torch.int64, device=scores.device)
+        if sample_token
+        else None
+    )
+    output_sampled_probs = (
+        torch.empty(scores.shape[0], dtype=torch.float32, device=scores.device)
+        if sample_token
+        else None
+    )
+    if scores.shape[0] == 0:
+        return output_probs, output_token_ids, output_sampled_probs
+
+    block_size = triton.next_power_of_2(scores.shape[1])
+    if temperatures is not None:
+        if (
+            rows_per_request < 1
+            or scores.shape[0] % rows_per_request != 0
+            or temperatures.shape != (scores.shape[0] // rows_per_request, 1)
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("Temperatures must match the SynthID request rows.")
+        if block_size > 1024:
+            raise ValueError("Fused temperature scaling requires top-k <= 1024.")
+    if block_size > 1024:
+        if keys.numel() > 64:
+            raise ValueError("The wide Triton SynthID path supports at most 64 keys.")
+        g_bits = torch.empty_like(token_ids)
+        _synthid_wide_topk_kernel[(scores.shape[0],)](
+            scores,
+            token_ids,
+            context_hashes,
+            keys,
+            apply_mask,
+            output_probs,
+            g_bits,
+            scores.stride(0),
+            token_ids.stride(0),
+            output_probs.stride(0),
+            g_bits.stride(0),
+            scores.shape[1],
+            keys.numel(),
+            return_probs=True,
+            BLOCK_SIZE=1024,
+            num_warps=8,
+            num_stages=1,
+        )
+        if exponential_noise is not None:
+            sampled_indices = (
+                output_probs / exponential_noise.clamp_min(1.1754943508222875e-38)
+            ).argmax(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
+            output_token_ids = token_ids.gather(1, sampled_indices).view(-1)
+            output_sampled_probs = output_probs.gather(1, sampled_indices).view(-1)
+        return output_probs, output_token_ids, output_sampled_probs
+    if exponential_noise is None:
+        exponential_noise = scores
+        noise_stride = 0
+    else:
+        noise_stride = exponential_noise.stride(0)
+    output_token_ids_ptr = (
+        output_token_ids if output_token_ids is not None else output_probs
+    )
+    output_sampled_probs_ptr = (
+        output_sampled_probs if output_sampled_probs is not None else output_probs
+    )
+
+    _synthid_topk_kernel[(scores.shape[0],)](
+        scores,
+        token_ids,
+        context_hashes,
+        keys,
+        apply_mask,
+        temperatures if temperatures is not None else scores,
+        exponential_noise,
+        output_probs,
+        output_token_ids_ptr,
+        output_sampled_probs_ptr,
+        sorted_tokens if sorted_tokens is not None else output_probs,
+        scores.stride(0),
+        token_ids.stride(0),
+        noise_stride,
+        output_probs.stride(0),
+        temperatures.stride(0) if temperatures is not None else 0,
+        num_candidates=scores.shape[1],
+        depth=keys.numel(),

+        sort_output=sorted_tokens is not None,

+        BLOCK_SIZE=block_size,

+def commit_synthid_token_triton(
+    token_ids: torch.Tensor,
+    slot_indices: torch.Tensor,
+    commit_mask: torch.Tensor,
+    context: torch.Tensor,
+    context_history: torch.Tensor,
+    history_cursor: torch.Tensor,

+    skip_first_ngram_calls: bool,

+        slot_indices,
+        context,

+        history_size=context_history.shape[1],

+@triton.jit
+def _lookup_sorted_sparse_prob(tokens, probs, token, TOP_K: tl.constexpr):

+    high = low + TOP_K
+    for _ in range(11):
+        mid = (low + high) // 2
+        in_bounds = mid < TOP_K
+        mid_token = tl.load(tokens + mid, mask=in_bounds, other=2147483647)
+        go_right = mid_token < token
+        low = tl.where(go_right, mid + 1, low)
+        high = tl.where(go_right, high, mid)
+    in_bounds = low < TOP_K
+    matched_token = tl.load(tokens + low, mask=in_bounds, other=-1)
+    matched_prob = tl.load(probs + low, mask=in_bounds, other=0.0)
+    return tl.where(in_bounds & (matched_token == token), matched_prob, 0.0)

+@triton.jit
+def _synthid_speculative_sampling_kernel(
+    Predicts,
+    AcceptIndex,
+    AcceptTokenNum,
+    Candidates,
+    RetrieveIndex,
+    UniformSamples,
+    UniformSamplesFinal,
+    TargetProbs,
+    TargetTokens,
+    DraftProbs,
+    DraftTokens,
+    stride_cand_b,
+    stride_cand_s,
+    stride_idx_b,
+    stride_idx_s,
+    stride_uni_b,
+    stride_uni_s,
+    stride_tp_b,
+    stride_tp_s,
+    stride_tp_k,
+    stride_tt_b,
+    stride_tt_s,
+    stride_tt_k,
+    stride_dp_b,
+    stride_dp_s,
+    stride_dp_k,
+    stride_dt_b,
+    stride_dt_s,
+    stride_dt_k,
+    NUM_SLOTS: tl.constexpr,
+    TOP_K: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    pid = tl.program_id(0)
+    offsets = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K)
+    candidate_mask = offsets < TOP_K
+    candidate_base = Candidates + pid * stride_cand_b
+    index_base = RetrieveIndex + pid * stride_idx_b
+    uniform_base = UniformSamples + pid * stride_uni_b
+    current_row = 0
+    num_correct_drafts = 0
+    continue_verifying = 1
+
+    root_index = tl.load(index_base)
+    tl.store(AcceptIndex + pid * stride_idx_b, root_index)
+    last_accept_index = root_index

+    step = 1
+    while (step < NUM_SLOTS) and (continue_verifying == 1):
+        draft_token = tl.load(candidate_base + step * stride_cand_s)
+        target_tokens = tl.load(
+            TargetTokens
+            + pid * stride_tt_b
+            + current_row * stride_tt_s
+            + offsets * stride_tt_k,
+            mask=candidate_mask,
+            other=-1,
+        )
+        target_probs = tl.load(
+            TargetProbs
+            + pid * stride_tp_b
+            + current_row * stride_tp_s
+            + offsets * stride_tp_k,
+            mask=candidate_mask,
+            other=0.0,
+        )

+                0.0,

+            axis=0,
+        )
+        draft_prob = _lookup_sorted_sparse_prob(
+            DraftTokens + pid * stride_dt_b + current_row * stride_dt_s,
+            DraftProbs + pid * stride_dp_b + current_row * stride_dp_s,
+            draft_token,
+            TOP_K=TOP_K,
+        )

+            current_index = tl.load(index_base + step * stride_idx_s)
+            tl.store(

+                current_index,

+    tl.store(AcceptTokenNum + pid, num_correct_drafts)
+    target_tokens = tl.load(
+        TargetTokens
+        + pid * stride_tt_b
+        + current_row * stride_tt_s
+        + offsets * stride_tt_k,
+        mask=candidate_mask,
+        other=-1,
+    )
+    target_probs = tl.load(
+        TargetProbs
+        + pid * stride_tp_b
+        + current_row * stride_tp_s
+        + offsets * stride_tp_k,
+        mask=candidate_mask,
+        other=0.0,
+    )
+    final_probs = target_probs
+    if continue_verifying == 0:
+        draft_probs = _lookup_sorted_sparse_prob(
+            DraftTokens + pid * stride_dt_b + current_row * stride_dt_s,
+            DraftProbs + pid * stride_dp_b + current_row * stride_dp_s,
+            target_tokens,
+            TOP_K=TOP_K,

+@triton.jit
+def _synthid_zero_step_kernel(
+    Probs,
+    UniformSamples,
+    OutputTokens,
+    stride_p_b,
+    stride_p_v,
+    VOCAB_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_V: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    pid = tl.program_id(0)
+    prob_base = Probs + pid * stride_p_b
+    norm_sum = 0.0
+    for v_start in range(0, VOCAB_SIZE, BLOCK_V):
+        offsets = v_start + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_V)
+        norm_sum += tl.sum(
+            tl.load(
+                prob_base + offsets * stride_p_v,
+                mask=offsets < VOCAB_SIZE,
+                other=0.0,
+            )
+        )
+
+    target = tl.load(UniformSamples + pid) * norm_sum
+    cumulative = 0.0
+    output_token = VOCAB_SIZE - 1
+    found = 0
+    for v_start in range(0, VOCAB_SIZE, BLOCK_V):
+        if found == 0:
+            offsets = v_start + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_V)
+            values = tl.load(
+                prob_base + offsets * stride_p_v,
+                mask=offsets < VOCAB_SIZE,
+                other=0.0,
+            )
+            block_cumsum = cumulative + tl.cumsum(values, axis=0)
+            matches = block_cumsum > target
+            if tl.max(matches, axis=0):
+                output_token = v_start + tl.argmax(matches.to(tl.int32), axis=0)
+                found = 1
+            cumulative += tl.sum(values)
+    tl.store(OutputTokens + pid, output_token)

+def sample_synthid_zero_step_triton(
+    *,

+    accept_index: torch.Tensor,
+    accept_token_num: torch.Tensor,
+    retrieve_index: torch.Tensor,
+    target_probs: torch.Tensor,
+    uniform_samples_for_final_sampling: torch.Tensor,

+    probs = target_probs[:, 0]
+    final_tokens = probs.new_empty((probs.shape[0],), dtype=torch.int64)

+        probs,
+        uniform_samples_for_final_sampling,
+        final_tokens,
+        probs.stride(0),
+        probs.stride(1),
+        VOCAB_SIZE=probs.shape[1],
+        BLOCK_V=4096,
+    )
+    accept_index[:, 0].copy_(retrieve_index[:, 0].to(accept_index.dtype))
+    accept_token_num.zero_()
+    predicts[retrieve_index[:, 0]] = final_tokens.to(predicts.dtype)
+

+"""Watermark algorithm initialization and ordinary Gumbel sampling lifecycle."""

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Optional
+
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_exec
+from sglang.srt.watermarking.synthid.setup import init_synthid_watermark
+
+from .core import WatermarkState

+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from sglang.srt.layers.sampler import Sampler
+
+
+def init_watermark_engine(
+    *, sampler: Sampler, request_pool, device, vocab_size: int
+) -> Optional[WatermarkState]:
+    features = get_exec().features
+    synthid_configured = get_exec().kernel.synthid_watermark_key_file is not None
+    if not features.enable_watermark and not synthid_configured:
+        return None
+    algorithm = features.watermark_algorithm or (
+        "synthid" if synthid_configured else "gumbel"
+    )
+    if algorithm == "synthid":
+        (
+            sampler.synthid_watermark,
+            sampler.use_ordinary_synthid_sampling,
+            sampler.use_fused_synthid_sampling,
+        ) = init_synthid_watermark(
+            num_slots=request_pool.req_to_token.shape[0],
+            device=device,
+            tp_sync_group=sampler.tp_sync_group,
+        )
+        return None
+    if algorithm != "gumbel":
+        raise ValueError("Unknown watermark algorithm in the published runtime")
+    state = WatermarkState(
+        max_num_reqs=request_pool.req_to_token.shape[0],
+        context_window=features.watermark_context_window,
+        max_contexts_per_req=request_pool.req_to_token.shape[1],

+        default_enabled=features.watermark_default_enabled,

+        device=device,
+    )
+    sampler.watermark_state = state

+"""Relay sparse ON and full-vocabulary OFF proposals without truncating OFF rows."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+
+
+def merge_proposals(left, left_ids, right, right_ids):
+    """A non-overlap merge may combine sparse ON and dense OFF input batches."""
+    if (left_ids is None) == (right_ids is None):
+        return torch.cat((left, right)), (
+            torch.cat((left_ids, right_ids)) if left_ids is not None else None
+        )
+    vocab_size = left.shape[-1] if left_ids is None else right.shape[-1]
+
+    def dense(probs, token_ids):
+        if token_ids is None:
+            return probs
+        return torch.zeros(
+            (*probs.shape[:-1], vocab_size), dtype=probs.dtype, device=probs.device
+        ).scatter_(-1, token_ids, probs)
+
+    return torch.cat((dense(left, left_ids), dense(right, right_ids))), None
+
+
+class RequestProposalRelay:
+    def __init__(self, *, slots: int, candidate_count: int, device):
+        self.slots = slots
+        self.candidate_count = candidate_count
+        self.device = device
+        self.sparse_probs = None
+        self.sparse_tokens = None
+        self.dense_probs = None
+        self._sparse_slots: list[bool | None] = [None] * slots
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _host_indices(indices, indices_cpu):
+        if indices_cpu is None:
+            if indices.device.type != "cpu":
+                raise RuntimeError("Proposal relay requires CPU request-slot metadata")
+            indices_cpu = indices
+        if indices_cpu.device.type != "cpu" or len(indices_cpu) != len(indices):
+            raise ValueError("Proposal relay CPU request-slot metadata mismatch")
+        return indices_cpu.tolist()
+
+    def store(self, indices, probs, token_ids, enabled_host, *, indices_cpu=None):
+        if probs is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("Per-request proposal relay has no probabilities")
+        if len(enabled_host) != len(indices):
+            raise ValueError("Per-request proposal policy cardinality mismatch")
+        slots = self._host_indices(indices, indices_cpu)
+        for slot in slots:
+            self._sparse_slots[slot] = token_ids is not None
+        if token_ids is not None:
+            if self.sparse_probs is None:
+                self.sparse_probs = torch.empty(
+                    (self.slots, probs.shape[1]), dtype=probs.dtype, device=self.device
+                )
+                self.sparse_tokens = torch.empty(
+                    (self.slots, probs.shape[1]),
+                    dtype=token_ids.dtype,
+                    device=self.device,
+                )
+            self.sparse_probs[indices] = probs
+            self.sparse_tokens[indices] = token_ids
+            return
+        if self.dense_probs is None:
+            self.dense_probs = torch.empty(
+                (self.slots, probs.shape[1]), dtype=probs.dtype, device=self.device
+            )
+        self.dense_probs[indices] = probs
+
+    def resolve(self, indices, state, *, indices_cpu=None):
+        enabled_host = state.request_enabled_host or [True] * len(indices)
+        slots = self._host_indices(indices, indices_cpu)
+        layouts = [self._sparse_slots[slot] for slot in slots]
+        if any(layout is None for layout in layouts):
+            raise RuntimeError("Proposal relay resolved an unstashed request slot")
+        if any(
+            layout and not enabled for layout, enabled in zip(layouts, enabled_host)
+        ):
+            raise RuntimeError("OFF proposal relay cannot consume a sparse ON payload")
+        if all(layouts):
+            if self.sparse_probs is None:
+                raise RuntimeError("ON proposal relay has no sparse payload")
+            return self.sparse_probs[indices], self.sparse_tokens[indices]
+        if self.dense_probs is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("OFF proposal relay has no full-vocabulary payload")
+        dense = self.dense_probs[indices]
+        sparse_rows = [i for i, layout in enumerate(layouts) if layout]
+        if sparse_rows:
+            if self.sparse_probs is None:
+                raise RuntimeError("Mixed proposal relay has no ON payload")
+            rows = torch.tensor(sparse_rows, dtype=torch.int64, device=self.device)
+            slots = indices[rows]
+            on_probs = torch.zeros_like(dense[rows]).scatter_(
+                1, self.sparse_tokens[slots], self.sparse_probs[slots]
+            )
+            dense[rows] = on_probs
+        if all(enabled_host):
+            # Compress only when a formerly mixed batch becomes homogeneous ON.
+            probs, tokens = torch.topk(
+                dense, min(self.candidate_count, dense.shape[-1]), dim=-1
+            )
+            tokens, order = tokens.sort(dim=-1)
+            return probs.gather(1, order), tokens
+        return dense, None

+"""Server-side algorithm selection and request watermark policy."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+from typing import Any
+
+from sglang.srt.arg_groups.model_override_base import ResolvedView
+
+from .config import WatermarkConfigError, _read_config_file, load_watermark_config
+from .core import resolve_watermark_request
+
+_SYNTHID_FIELDS = {
+    "ngram_len": "synthid_watermark_ngram_len",
+    "top_k": "synthid_watermark_top_k",
+    "context_history_size": "synthid_watermark_context_history_size",
+    "skip_first_ngram_calls": "synthid_watermark_skip_first_ngram_calls",
+}
+
+
+def resolve_watermark_config(view: ResolvedView) -> dict:
+    has_key_file = view.synthid_watermark_key_file is not None
+    enabled = view.enable_watermark or has_key_file
+    algorithm = view.watermark_algorithm or ("synthid" if has_key_file else "gumbel")
+    if algorithm not in {"synthid", "gumbel"}:
+        raise ValueError("watermark algorithm must be synthid or gumbel")
+    if has_key_file and algorithm != "synthid":
+        raise ValueError("SynthID key configuration cannot be combined with Gumbel")
+    if not enabled:
+        if view.watermark_config is not None or view.watermark_algorithm is not None:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "--watermark-config and --watermark-algorithm require --enable-watermark"
+            )
+        return {}
+    resolved = {"enable_watermark": True, "watermark_algorithm": algorithm}
+    if view.watermark_config is None:
+        if algorithm == "synthid" and not has_key_file:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "SynthID requires a key file in --watermark-config or "
+                "--synthid-watermark-key-file"
+            )
+        return resolved
+    if algorithm == "gumbel":
+        config = load_watermark_config(view.watermark_config)
+        resolved.update(
+            {
+                f"watermark_{field}": value
+                for field in config.__struct_fields__
+                if (value := getattr(config, field)) is not None
+            }
+        )
+        return resolved
+
+    raw = _load_synthid_config(view.watermark_config)
+    key_file = raw.get("key_file")
+    if key_file is None and "keys" in raw:
+        key_file = view.watermark_config
+    if not isinstance(key_file, str) or not key_file:
+        raise WatermarkConfigError(
+            "SynthID config requires key_file or an integer keys list"
+        )
+    if has_key_file and key_file != view.synthid_watermark_key_file:
+        raise ValueError("Conflicting SynthID key files")
+    resolved["synthid_watermark_key_file"] = key_file
+    for field, destination in _SYNTHID_FIELDS.items():
+        if field in raw:
+            resolved[destination] = raw[field]
+    for name in ("default_enabled", "enforce_all"):
+        if name in raw:
+            resolved[f"watermark_{name}"] = raw[name]
+    return resolved
+
+
+def _load_synthid_config(source: str) -> dict:
+    if source.lstrip().startswith("{"):
+        raise WatermarkConfigError(
+            "SynthID configuration must use a secret file, not inline JSON"
+        )
+    payload = _read_config_file(source)
+    if len(payload.encode("utf-8")) > 4096:
+        raise WatermarkConfigError("watermark config exceeds 4096 bytes")
+    try:
+        raw = json.loads(payload)
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        raise WatermarkConfigError("failed to read watermark config JSON") from None
+    if not isinstance(raw, dict) or set(raw) - {
+        "key_file",
+        "keys",
+        "default_enabled",
+        "enforce_all",
+        *_SYNTHID_FIELDS,
+    }:
+        raise WatermarkConfigError("SynthID config must be an object with known fields")
+    if "keys" in raw and "key_file" in raw:
+        raise WatermarkConfigError("SynthID config cannot combine keys and key_file")
+    for name in ("ngram_len", "top_k", "context_history_size"):
+        if name in raw and type(raw[name]) is not int:
+            raise WatermarkConfigError(f"SynthID config {name} must be an integer")
+    for name in ("skip_first_ngram_calls", "default_enabled", "enforce_all"):
+        if name in raw and type(raw[name]) is not bool:
+            raise WatermarkConfigError(f"SynthID config {name} must be a boolean")
+    return raw
+
+
+def validate_watermark_request(sampling_params: Any, features: Any) -> bool:
+    watermark = sampling_params.watermark
+    if features.enable_watermark and features.watermark_algorithm == "synthid":
+        if watermark is not None:
+            if watermark.key is not None or watermark.context_window is not None:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "SynthID keys and context are server-wide, not per-request"
+                )
+            if watermark.enabled is None:
+                raise ValueError("SynthID request watermark must set enabled")
+            if watermark.enabled is False and features.watermark_enforce_all:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "request watermark enabled=false is not allowed when enforce_all is set"
+                )
+        return features.watermark_enforce_all or (
+            watermark.enabled
+            if watermark is not None
+            else features.watermark_default_enabled
+        )
+    _, _, enabled = resolve_watermark_request(
+        watermark,
+        server_enabled=features.enable_watermark,
+        default_key=features.watermark_key,
+        default_context_window=features.watermark_context_window,
+        default_enabled=features.watermark_default_enabled,
+        enforce_all=features.watermark_enforce_all,
+    )
+    return enabled

+"""Request policy and mixed-batch routing around the unchanged SynthID transform."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.watermarking.synthid.state import SynthIDState
+
+
+def request_enabled(request, features) -> bool:
+    control = request.sampling_params.watermark
+    if control is None:
+        return features.watermark_default_enabled or features.watermark_enforce_all
+    if control.enabled is False and features.watermark_enforce_all:
+        raise ValueError("SynthID enforce_all does not allow explicit opt-out")
+    return control.enabled is True
+
+
+def is_mixed(state) -> bool:
+    return (
+        isinstance(state, SynthIDState)
+        and state.request_enabled_host is not None
+        and any(state.request_enabled_host)
+        and not all(state.request_enabled_host)
+    )
+
+
+def is_enabled(state) -> bool:
+    if state is None:
+        return False
+    return (
+        not isinstance(state, SynthIDState)
+        or state.request_enabled_host is None
+        or any(state.request_enabled_host)
+    )
+
+
+def apply_mixed_logits(
+    *,
+    processor,
+    logits,
+    temperatures,
+    state,
+    verify_tokens=None,
+    prior_tokens=None,
+    draft=False,
+    filter_probs=None,
+    off_filter_probs=None,
+):
+    """Retain the full base vocabulary for OFF rows; only ON rows get Algorithm 5."""
+    raw = logits.clone()
+    if verify_tokens is not None:
+        processor.apply(
+            logits,
+            temperatures,
+            state,
+            verify_tokens=verify_tokens,
+            filter_probs=filter_probs,
+        )
+        rows_per_request = verify_tokens.shape[1]
+    elif draft:
+        processor.apply_draft(
+            logits,
+            temperatures,
+            state,
+            prior_draft_tokens=prior_tokens,
+            filter_probs=filter_probs,
+        )
+        rows_per_request = 1
+    else:
+        processor.apply(logits, temperatures, state, filter_probs=filter_probs)
+        rows_per_request = 1
+    enabled = state.request_enabled.repeat_interleave(rows_per_request)[:, None]
+    scaled = raw / temperatures.repeat_interleave(rows_per_request, dim=0)
+    if off_filter_probs is not None:
+        scaled = torch.log(off_filter_probs(torch.softmax(scaled, dim=-1)))
+    logits.copy_(torch.where(enabled, logits, scaled))
+
+
+def forward_mixed(
+    *,
+    sampler,
+    logits_output,
+    sampling_info,
+    return_logprob,
+    top_logprobs_nums,
+    token_ids_logprobs,
+    positions,
+):

+    from sglang.srt.layers import sampler as sampler_module

+        attach_sampling_mask,
+        filter_synthid_probs,
+    )
+
+    logits = sampler._preprocess_logits(logits_output.next_token_logits, sampling_info)
+    raw = logits.clone()
+    temperatures = sampling_info.temperatures
+    base_probs = torch.softmax(raw / temperatures, dim=-1)
+    has_filters = (
+        sampling_info.need_top_k_sampling
+        or sampling_info.need_top_p_sampling
+        or sampling_info.need_min_p_sampling

+    filtered_base = (
+        filter_synthid_probs(base_probs, sampling_info) if has_filters else base_probs
+    )
+    apply_mixed_logits(
+        processor=sampler.synthid_watermark,
+        logits=logits,
+        temperatures=temperatures,
+        state=sampling_info.synthid_state,
+        filter_probs=(
+            (lambda probs: filter_synthid_probs(probs, sampling_info))
+            if has_filters
+            else None
+        ),
+    )
+    enabled = sampling_info.synthid_state.request_enabled[:, None]
+    probs = torch.where(enabled, torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1), filtered_base)
+    greedy = (sampling_info.top_ks <= 1)[:, None]
+    greedy_probs = torch.zeros_like(probs).scatter_(
+        1, raw.argmax(dim=-1, keepdim=True), 1
+    )
+    probs = torch.where(greedy, greedy_probs, probs)
+    tokens = sampler_module.sampling_from_probs_torch(
+        probs,
+        sampling_seed=sampling_info.sampling_seed,
+        positions=positions,
+        synthid_applied=True,

+        )

+class _MixedTargetGraph:
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        processor: SynthIDWatermarkProcessor,
+        batch_size: int,
+        rows_per_request: int,
+        vocab_size: int,
+        stream,
+        pool,
+        sample_draft: bool,
+    ):
+        self.batch_size = batch_size
+        self.rows_per_request = rows_per_request
+        self.sample_draft = sample_draft
+        device = processor.keys.device
+        rows = batch_size * rows_per_request

+            batch_size, 1, dtype=torch.float32, device=device

+        stream.wait_stream(current)

+            self._transform(processor=processor)
+            self._transform(processor=processor)

+            self.output = self._transform(processor=processor)
+        current.wait_stream(stream)
+
+    def _transform(
+        self, *, processor: SynthIDWatermarkProcessor
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        logits = self.logits.clone()
+        processor._apply_with_hashes(
+            logits,
+            self.temperatures,
+            self.hashes,
+            self.apply_mask,
+            batch_size=self.batch_size,
+            rows_per_request=self.rows_per_request,
+            scatter_to_logits=True,
+            keys=processor.keys,
+        )
+        enabled = self.enabled.repeat_interleave(self.rows_per_request)[:, None]

+            self.rows_per_request, dim=0
+        )
+        output = torch.where(enabled, logits, scaled)
+        if not self.sample_draft:
+            return output
+        from sglang.srt.speculative.spec_utils import fast_sample

+        probs = torch.softmax(output, dim=-1)
+        sampled_probs, sampled_tokens = fast_sample(probs, num_samples=1)
+        return probs, sampled_probs, sampled_tokens
+
+    def replay(
+        self,
+        *,
+        logits: torch.Tensor,
+        temperatures: torch.Tensor,
+        hashes: torch.Tensor,
+        apply_mask: torch.Tensor,
+        enabled: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        raw_bs = temperatures.shape[0]
+        rows = logits.shape[0]

+            self.logits.zero_()
+            self.temperatures.fill_(1)
+            self.hashes.zero_()
+            self.apply_mask.zero_()
+            self.enabled.zero_()
+        torch._foreach_copy_(
+            [self.logits[:rows], self.temperatures[:raw_bs]],
+            [logits, temperatures],
+        )
+        self.hashes[:rows].copy_(hashes)
+        torch._foreach_copy_(
+            [self.apply_mask[:rows], self.enabled[:raw_bs]], [apply_mask, enabled]
+        )
+        self.graph.replay()
+        if isinstance(self.output, tuple):
+            probs, sampled_probs, sampled_tokens = self.output
+            return probs[:rows], sampled_probs[:rows], sampled_tokens[:rows]
+        return self.output[:rows]
+
+
+class MixedTargetGraphs:
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        processor: SynthIDWatermarkProcessor,
+        capture_bs: list[int],
+        rows_per_request: int,
+        vocab_size: int,
+        sample_draft: bool = False,
+    ):
+        self.batch_sizes = tuple(sorted(set(capture_bs)))
+        stream = torch.cuda.Stream(device=processor.keys.device)
+        pool = torch.cuda.graph_pool_handle()
+        self.entries = {
+            bs: _MixedTargetGraph(
+                processor=processor,
+                batch_size=bs,
+                rows_per_request=rows_per_request,
+                vocab_size=vocab_size,
+                stream=stream,
+                pool=pool,
+                sample_draft=sample_draft,
+            )
+            for bs in self.batch_sizes
+        }
+
+    def apply(
+        self,
+        *,
+        logits: torch.Tensor,
+        temperatures: torch.Tensor,
+        hashes: torch.Tensor,
+        apply_mask: torch.Tensor,
+        enabled: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> bool:
+        index = bisect_left(self.batch_sizes, temperatures.shape[0])
+        if index == len(self.batch_sizes):
+            return False
+        output = self.entries[self.batch_sizes[index]].replay(
+            logits=logits,
+            temperatures=temperatures,
+            hashes=hashes,
+            apply_mask=apply_mask,
+            enabled=enabled,
+        )
+        if not isinstance(output, torch.Tensor):
+            raise RuntimeError("Target transform graph returned draft samples")
+        logits.copy_(output)
+        return True
+
+    def sample(
+        self,
+        *,
+        logits: torch.Tensor,
+        temperatures: torch.Tensor,
+        hashes: torch.Tensor,
+        apply_mask: torch.Tensor,
+        enabled: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor] | None:
+        index = bisect_left(self.batch_sizes, temperatures.shape[0])
+        if index == len(self.batch_sizes):
+            return None
+        output = self.entries[self.batch_sizes[index]].replay(
+            logits=logits,
+            temperatures=temperatures,
+            hashes=hashes,
+            apply_mask=apply_mask,
+            enabled=enabled,
+        )
+        if not isinstance(output, tuple):
+            raise RuntimeError("Draft sample graph returned only target logits")
+        return output

+"""Validate SynthID configuration during ServerArgs resolution."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+from typing import Callable
+
+from sglang.srt.arg_groups.model_override_base import ResolvedView
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.watermarking.synthid.state import load_synthid_keys
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+def validate_synthid_watermark(
+    *,
+    view: ResolvedView,
+    key_file: str | None,
+    ngram_len: int,
+    top_k: int,
+    context_history_size: int,
+    rl_on_policy_target: str | None,
+    speculative_algorithm: str | None,
+    cuda_is_available: Callable[[], bool],
+) -> None:
+    if envs.SGLANG_RETURN_WATERMARKED_LOGPROB.get():
+        if envs.SGLANG_RETURN_ORIGINAL_LOGPROB.get():
+            raise ValueError(
+                "SGLANG_RETURN_WATERMARKED_LOGPROB and "
+                "SGLANG_RETURN_ORIGINAL_LOGPROB are mutually exclusive."
+            )
+        if key_file is None:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "SGLANG_RETURN_WATERMARKED_LOGPROB requires "
+                "--synthid-watermark-key-file."
+            )
+        if view.speculative_algorithm:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "SGLANG_RETURN_WATERMARKED_LOGPROB requires non-speculative decoding."
+            )
+    if key_file is None:
+        return
+
+    if ngram_len < 2:
+        raise ValueError("--synthid-watermark-ngram-len must be at least 2.")
+    if not 2 <= top_k <= 65536:
+        raise ValueError("--synthid-watermark-top-k must be in [2, 65536].")
+    if context_history_size < 1:
+        raise ValueError("--synthid-watermark-context-history-size must be positive.")
+    if view.device != "cuda" or not cuda_is_available():
+        raise ValueError("SynthID watermarking requires NVIDIA CUDA.")
+    if view.is_embedding or view.dllm_algorithm is not None:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "SynthID watermarking requires autoregressive text generation."
+        )
+    if view.disaggregation_mode != "null":
+        raise ValueError("SynthID watermarking does not support PD disaggregation.")
+    if rl_on_policy_target is not None:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "SynthID watermarking is incompatible with --rl-on-policy-target "
+            "because it intentionally changes the rollout distribution."
+        )
+    if view.sampling_backend not in ("flashinfer", "pytorch"):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "SynthID watermarking currently requires the built-in "
+            "flashinfer or pytorch sampling backend."
+        )
+
+    keys = load_synthid_keys(key_file)
+    if len(keys) > 64:
+        raise ValueError("SynthID supports at most 64 watermark keys.")
+
+    algorithm = (view.speculative_algorithm or "").upper()
+    if algorithm:
+        if view.pp_size > 1:
+            raise ValueError("SynthID does not support pipeline-parallel speculation.")
+        supported = {"EAGLE", "STANDALONE"}
+        if algorithm not in supported:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "SynthID watermarking currently supports non-speculative "
+                "decoding and linear EAGLE-family speculative decoding; got "
+                f"--speculative-algorithm={speculative_algorithm}."
+            )
+        if view.speculative_eagle_topk != 1:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "SynthID watermarking with speculative decoding requires "
+                "--speculative-eagle-topk=1."
+            )
+        if view.speculative_token_map is not None:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "SynthID watermarking does not support --speculative-token-map."
+            )
+        if view.enable_multi_layer_eagle:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "SynthID watermarking does not yet support --enable-multi-layer-eagle."
+            )
+        if view.disaggregation_mode != "null":
+            raise ValueError(
+                "SynthID watermarking with speculative decoding does not yet "
+                "support PD disaggregation."
+            )
+        if not view.speculative_use_rejection_sampling:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "SynthID watermarking with speculative decoding requires "
+                "--speculative-use-rejection-sampling."
+            )
+
+    logger.info(
+        "Enabled SynthID Text watermarking "
+        "(ngram_len=%d, depth=%d, top_k=%d, history=%d).",
+        view.synthid_watermark_ngram_len,
+        len(keys),
+        view.synthid_watermark_top_k,
+        view.synthid_watermark_context_history_size,
+    )

+def synthid_graph_config(
+    *,
+    processor: Optional[SynthIDWatermarkProcessor],
+    num_steps: int,
+    rejection_sampling: bool,
+) -> tuple[bool, bool]:
+    supported = (
+        processor is not None
+        and processor.config.context_history_size <= 2048
+        and processor.config.context_width <= 16

+        or sampling_info.synthid_state is None
+        or not graph_supported
+        or sampling_info.sampling_seed is not None

+
